parameters.name: AllowReport
parameters.description:
Specifies whether endpoint users are allowed to submit a filing request for this policy. Valid values:
- **true**: Filing is allowed. A filing entry is provided in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.
- **false**: Filing is not allowed.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the software prohibition policy. The description can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be left empty.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
- **true**: Enabled. The policy is delivered to endpoints and takes effect.
- **false**: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to endpoints.

parameters.name: ForceKill
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly terminate running software processes. Valid values:
- **true**: The endpoint immediately terminates the running processes of the software when the policy is triggered.
- **false**: Running processes are not terminated. Only subsequent launches are blocked.

parameters.name: MainButtonTextCh
parameters.description: The Chinese text of the primary button in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: MainButtonTextEn
parameters.description: The English text of the primary button in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
The scope in which the policy takes effect. Valid values:
- **UserGroupAll**: Takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account. No user group needs to be specified.
- **UserGroupNormal**: Takes effect only for users in the user groups specified by UserGroupIds.

parameters.name: MinorButtonTextCh
parameters.description: The Chinese text of the secondary button in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: MinorButtonTextEn
parameters.description: The English text of the secondary button in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Policy Name of the software prohibition policy. Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description:
The object type. Valid values:
- **App**: Controls by prohibited software. The controlled objects are specified by SoftwareIds.
- **Tag**: Controls by prohibited software tag. The controlled objects are specified by TagIds. All prohibited software under the specified tags is controlled.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the software prohibition policy.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The action to take. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. Valid values:
- **Ban**: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user.
- **BanSilent**: Blocks the software from running without notifying the user (silent blocking).
- **Warn**: Displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user without blocking the software from running.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: PromptCh
parameters.description: The Chinese prompt content displayed in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: PromptEn
parameters.description: The English prompt content displayed in the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: SoftwareIds
parameters.description: The collection of prohibited software directly controlled by this policy.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The collection of prohibited software tag IDs controlled by this policy.

parameters.name: TitleCh
parameters.description: The Chinese title of the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: TitleEn
parameters.description: The English title of the pop-up notification on the endpoint.

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: The collection of user group IDs for which the policy takes effect. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Whitelist
parameters.description: The list of exempted usernames. Duplicate values are not allowed.
